narrative.overview: The Santos & Trevizan visual system balances the gravitas and rigor of Brazilian jurisprudence with warm, empathetic modern clarity. Visual weight rests on Chamber Navy (#1D2A3D) anchored by Warm Parchment (#D9D8D3) surfaces and Old Gold (#B8924A) accents.
keyCharacteristics: Prestige without Pretense (navy and gold framed by warm parchment)

rules.name: The Action Exclusivity Rule
rules.body: Action Green (#25D366) is exclusively reserved for direct client communication channels (WhatsApp triage, consultation booking).

rules.name: The Golden Precision Rule
rules.body: Old Gold is an accent, not a fill. It appears in delicate structural strokes, icon lines, and refined borders; it never dominates large background planes.

rules.name: The Plain Language Rule
rules.body: Body text must remain generous in line-height (1.6+) and never drop below 15px.

rules.name: The Grounded Surface Rule
rules.body: Deep navy surfaces use tone shifts (#1D2A3D to #243350) rather than dark drop shadows to create spatial layering.

dos: Do maintain strong contrast ratios across all text.
Do preserve structured WhatsApp triage messages per practice area.
Do maintain generous whitespace and line-height on legal explanations.
Do keep touch targets on mobile at least 48x48px.
donts: Don't use legal stock clichés (wooden gavels, blindfolded lady justice, marble columns).
Don't apply AI side-tab borders (thick unilateral colored borders).
Don't use Action Green for anything other than direct communication.
Don't use high-pressure sales urgency patterns or popups.
